model.description: A small six-layer English sentence encoder producing normalized 384-dimensional vectors locally for semantic similarity and retrieval.
limitations: Primarily English; multilingual retrieval is not certified.
Inputs beyond 256 wordpieces are truncated; chunk long documents.
Similarity does not verify facts and may reproduce training-data biases.
Close rankings and domain-specific text require application evaluation.
Do not use similarity alone for consequential decisions about people.

benchmark.qualityGate: Finite normalized distinct 384d vectors; relevant passage cosine exceeds unrelated passage by >=0.1.
